description: Schema for one sworn assertion record in a Signet ledger. A record is schema-valid when it conforms here; it is trustworthy only when its evidence cites verified sources and its seal verifies (recomputed record_hash matches, prev_hash links the chain).

agent.description: Public name of the signing agent — the name on the line.

assertion_id.description: signet-genesis for the anchor; signet-YYYY-NNNN for sworn assertions.

claim.description: The sworn statement, plain language. The genesis block's claim MUST state it is the ledger opening and make no rights claim.

evidence.description: At least one evidence entry. Claims without evidence do not seal.

source.description: Human-readable source of the evidence (article, scan, owner confirmation).

prev_hash.description: record_hash of the previous block; the literal string GENESIS for the anchor.

record_hash.description: sha256 hex over (prev_hash + newline + canonical record body).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the sealing.

work.description: The track / work the claim is about; the ledger opening is labeled '(ledger opening)'.

title: THE SIGNET assertion record
